Getting Started

Installing of required packages

               ggraph, visNetwork, plotly, DT,
               gganimate, tidytext, stringdist)

Confirm John Windward’s event on May 17

john_may17 <- mc2_events %>%
  filter(map_lgl(parties, ~ "person:john_windward" %in% .x)) %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) == as.Date("2046-05-17")) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, details.from, details.to,
         details.content, details.forum, details.poster_id,
         details.a2a.from, details.a2a.to, details.a2a.action)

datatable(john_may17,
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10),
          caption = "John Windward's Events on May 17, 2046")

Narrow down to specific anomalous post

anomalous_post <- mc2_events %>%
  filter(short_name %in% c("saidit_post", "post_saidit")) %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) == as.Date("2046-05-17")) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.forum,
         details.poster_id, details.content, 
         details.content_source)

datatable(anomalous_post, 
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10),
          caption = "SaidIT Posts on May 17, 2046")
NoteKey Finding

The anomalous post is event ID 373902, posted at 2046-05-17T11:21:15Z but this is in UTC which in US Eastern time is on 4.21am, which matches the challenge description. In addition details.forum:general coincide with the challenge description that its posted in a random forum.

Find difference between saidit_post and post_saidit

bind_rows(
  mc2_events %>% filter(short_name == "saidit_post") %>% head(5),
  mc2_events %>% filter(short_name == "post_saidit") %>% head(5)
) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.forum,
         details.poster_id, details.content,
         details.content_source) %>%
  datatable(options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5),
           caption = "Comparing saidit_post vs post_saidit action types")
NoteKey Findings

saidit_post events show parties as person:... and post_saidit events show parties as Agent/person:...,system:saidit, which means saidit_post should be posted by the person themselves and post_saidit are posted by an agent on behalf of the person.

Conclusion on the anomalous post

The post has short_name as saidit_post but under parties as Agent/person:john_windward,system:saidit which is weird as concluded that saidit_post should be posted by the person so John himself. But parties shows that its posted by John’s agent instead.

In addition based on John’s event on May 17, there was only check_email. He was also not active on 4:21 am, which means his agent acted autonomously.

Check all people in Tenant Thread with their titles and teams

org_nodes %>%
  filter(type == "person") %>%
  select(id, label, title) %>%
  left_join(
    org_edges %>% select(source, target, relation),

  mutate(department_or_team = source) %>%
  select(person_id = id, name = label, title,
         department_or_team) %>%
  arrange(department_or_team) %>%
  datatable(options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 15),
            caption = "All People in Tenant Thread")

Context of John’s World

John leads Customer Support which contains 4 teams: Phone Center, Billing, Concierge and Public Relations. The Customer Support sits directly under company:tenant_thread.

Check any activities with John in parties within 2 hours before post

pre_post <- mc2_events %>%
  filter(datetime >= anchor_time - hours(2),
         datetime <= anchor_time) %>%
  filter(map_lgl(parties, 
                 ~ any(str_detect(.x, "john_windward")))) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.from,
         details.task, details.a2a.from, details.a2a.to,
         details.a2a.action, details.forum, details.target_agent)

datatable(pre_post, 
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
          caption = "2 hours before anomalous post - John Windward events")
NoteKey Findings At This Point

The anchor event content source is from SwiftWren.txt which should be the file that contained the gibberish content. In addition, from the 2-hour window, there are only 3 events related to John shows and they all happen within 3 seconds. Agent/person:chloe_ballast queued a task that triggered John’s agent, which means that Chloe Ballast’s agent iniitated this not John’s.

# Check ALL queue_subordinate_task with read_file task in entire dataset
full_propagation <- mc2_events %>%
  filter(short_name == "queue_subordinate_task",
         details.task == "read_file") %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, parties, details.target_agent) %>%
  mutate(
    sender = map_chr(parties, ~ {
      target <- details.target_agent[1]
      others <- .x[!str_detect(.x, fixed(str_remove(target, "Agent/")))]
      if(length(others) > 0) others[1] else NA_character_
    }),
    receiver = details.target_agent
  )

Understanding SwiftWren.txt

What is SwiftWren.txt?

swiftwren <- mc2_events %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(coalesce(details.file, ""), "SwitfWren") |
      str_detect(coalesce(details.content_source, ""), "SwiftWren") |
      str_detect(coalesce(details.file_saved, ""), "SwitfWren")
  ) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.file,
         details.file_saved, details.content_source,
         details.content)

datatable(swiftwren,
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
          caption = "All events referencing SwiftWren.txt")
NoteKey Finding

Since it can only be found once during the anchor event, it means it was created and used without leaving a broader trail. Next course of action should be to search more broadly for it.

Search more broadly for SwiftWren

mc2_events %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(coalesce(details.file, ""), 
               regex("swift|wren", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
      str_detect(coalesce(details.content_source, ""),
                 regex("swift|wren", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
      str_detect(coalesce(details.file_saved, ""),
                 regex("swift|wren", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
      str_detect(coalesce(details.content, ""), 
                 regex("swift|wren", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.file, 
         details.file_saved, details.content_source, 
         details.content) %>%
  datatable(options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
            caption = "Broader search for SwiftWren references")
